frequency_question: How often do proposed high-stakes bilateral tariffs reach implementation within the threatened window rather than resulting in negotiated delays or withdrawals?
membership_rule: Includes publicly announced sweeping tariff threats by a major economy directed at a top trading partner involving strategic goods where implementation deadlines are set under 180 days. Excludes multilateral trade sanctions and general WTO dispute outcomes.
coverage_note: 6 named prominent bilateral tariff threat episodes; believed to represent the primary instances meeting strict criteria for sudden major threats within this timeframe.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sector-specific antidumping duties which almost always reach implementation.
validity_reason: Trade policy execution dynamics remain structurally stable across recent political cycles.
